attribution.datasetAttribution: OPRA (Open Profiles for Revealing Audio) — https://github.com/opra-project/OPRA
attribution.presetAttributionRule: Preset creator credited prominently per row; OPRA repository link kept as the verifiable source URL on every record.
attribution.upstreamCaveat: Many EQ records derive from AutoEq contributor measurements (oratory1990 et al.). Full author + measurer + OPRA chains are preserved per record; nothing is laundered into a generic OPRA label.

evidence: LICENSE.md: 'Dataset:' headed CC BY-SA 4.0 full text + 'Code:' MIT (fetched live 2026-09-15)
README FAQ: code MIT / manufacturer+product+EQ data CC BY-SA 4.0, two-level attribution (browser logo+description+link; preset creator prominent + OPRA link)
audit.posture: UNCHANGED — bulk ingestion proceeds under the same CC BY-SA terms as the validated PoC

bundled.measurementsNote: OPRA hosts EQ presets, not raw measurement curves; references are preserved as display-text credits (measurementRef), never fabricated into data.
bundled.targetsNote: No numeric target files bundled; target identity (e.g. Harman Target) is preserved as display text only.

categories.duplicate: Records kept separate under a disambiguated id and flagged for review (upstream duplicate vendor directories, or naming overlap with a hand-reviewed seed id).
categories.imported: Records that passed every gate and ship in src/catalog/generated.ts.
categories.manualReview: Imported records carrying an explicit review note (band-count outliers, out-of-range values, seed-id collision).
categories.metadataOnly: Imported devices with no bundled preset (facts + outbound link only).
categories.presetOnly: Imported presets attached to a device (deviceId linkage); standalone tutorial preset excluded from this count.
categories.rejected: Records excluded from the build with a recorded reason.
categories.unresolvedProvenance: Records missing required creator/source information. Zero: the adapter rejects author/details gaps, so none ship.

determinism: Running ingestion twice against the frozen snapshot produces byte-identical output (asserted by opra-bulk.test.ts). The committed generated layer equals pipeline output (asserted).

manualReview.note: device id apple-airpods-pro-2 for apple::airpods_pro_2 collides with a hand-reviewed seed id: kept separate as apple-airpods-pro-2-2 (naming overlap, needs review)
N-band presets exceed the 12-band editor (kept whole; UI truncates per OPRA schema guidance)
out-of-range band values kept as-is (downstream clamps; never silently repaired)

rejectionReasons.reason: Rtings-linked record (author or details): excluded under the restrictive-upstream posture
non-finite gain (must be a finite number)

shareAlike.adaptedMaterial: src/catalog/generated.ts carries a CC BY-SA 4.0 data-license header + attribution + upstream-caveat note and must be shared under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible license.
shareAlike.codeLicense: MIT — the surrounding application code is a separate work under a separate license and is NOT relicensed by the data.
shareAlike.uiNotice: Devices → Sources & licenses names the ShareAlike sources and states the code/data split where the data lives.

snapshot.consumption: Single research-scale fetch of the documented consumer dump. No runtime requests; production reads only this frozen file via a lazily-loaded chunk.

source: OPRA (Open Profiles for Revealing Audio) — https://github.com/opra-project/OPRA
